notes.title: Small changes of the first day
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone, Small changes of the first day
[/h1][p][b]-Changed the speed of the turret movement[/b][/p][p][b]-Changed the delay time of the lasers[/b][/p][p][b]-Fixed the error with the country toy[/b][/p][p][b]-Decreased the number of spiders in the 2nd room[/b][/p][p][b]-Optimized the 2nd room[/b][/p][p][b]-Fixed some small bugs[/b][/p][p][b]-Corrected localization
[/b][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who played, I will be very glad to your feedback, also visit our discord channel
